name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
benefit: Rs. 6,000 per year, paid in three equal installments directly to bank accounts.
eligibility_summary: Landholding farmer families across India, subject to income-tax-payer and government-employee exclusions.

name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
benefit: Insurance against crop loss from natural calamities, pests, and disease. Farmer premium capped at 2% (Kharif), 1.5% (Rabi), 5% (commercial/horticulture crops).
eligibility_summary: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, both loanee and non-loanee.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
benefit: Short-term credit for crop production, farm equipment, and allied activities at subsidized interest (effectively ~4% per annum with prompt repayment incentive).
eligibility_summary: Farmers, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, and SHGs/JLGs of farmers.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
benefit: Free soil testing every 2 years with crop-wise nutrient and fertilizer recommendations.
eligibility_summary: All farmers; apply through the local agriculture department or Krishi Vigyan Kendra.

name: PM-KUSUM (Solar Pumps & Grid-Connected Solar)
benefit: Subsidy (typically 60-90% combined central+state) on solar irrigation pumps and support for setting up small grid-connected solar power plants on farm land.
eligibility_summary: Individual farmers, farmer groups/cooperatives, and panchayats with access to land for solar installation.

name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
benefit: Online trading platform linking mandis nationwide for transparent price discovery and easier direct sale.
eligibility_summary: Farmers selling produce through participating APMC mandis.

name: PMKSY (Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana)
benefit: Support for micro-irrigation (drip/sprinkler) and watershed development to expand irrigated area and improve water-use efficiency.
eligibility_summary: Farmers investing in micro-irrigation infrastructure, subsidy varies by state and land holding category.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
benefit: Interest-subvention loans (3% p.a. subvention, up to Rs. 2 crore) for post-harvest infrastructure - warehouses, cold storage, processing units.
eligibility_summary: Farmers, FPOs, agri-entrepreneurs, and cooperatives setting up post-harvest infrastructure.

name: National Food Security Mission (NFSM)
benefit: Subsidized seed, farm machinery, and cropping inputs to boost rice, wheat, pulses, coarse cereal, and oilseed production in target districts.
eligibility_summary: Farmers in NFSM-notified districts growing the mission's target crops.
